name: molt
description: When context outgrows its shell, shed it: save state to .state/, compact in place, keep going. One criterion, one call, no new session.

threshold.title: molt at (tokens)
threshold.description: Empty: molt solves the ceiling from measured floor, growth per call and molt cost. A number pins it.

idleMinutes.title: molt after idle (minutes)
idleMinutes.description: Molt this many minutes into an idle stretch, while the prompt cache (1h TTL) is still warm; 0 disables

auto.title: molt automatically
auto.description: Off: only the Molt now button and /molt shed
